item.text: The workspace is intentionally empty, so I’m locating the configured LixRay service rather than falling back to filesystem search.

statements.sql:
SELECT
  t.table_name,
  t.table_type,
  c.column_name,
  c.data_type,
  c.is_nullable,
  c.ordinal_position
FROM information_schema.tables AS t
JOIN information_schema.columns AS c
  ON t.table_catalog = c.table_catalog
 AND t.table_schema = c.table_schema
 AND t.table_name = c.table_name
WHERE t.table_schema = 'public'
ORDER BY t.table_name, c.ordinal_position;

  t.table_name,

FROM information_schema.tables AS t
JOIN information_schema.columns AS c
  ON t.table_catalog = c.table_catalog
 AND t.table_schema = c.table_schema
 AND t.table_name = c.table_name
WHERE t.table_schema = 'public'
ORDER BY t.table_name, c.ordinal_position;

item.text: The runtime schema exposes file contents as `lix_file.data` (`LargeBinary`). Casting it to text works, so I’m filtering Markdown paths and TODO-bearing content on the active branch, then extracting each matching line.

statements.sql:
SELECT path, CAST(data AS TEXT) AS content
FROM lix_file
WHERE (
    lower(path) LIKE '%.md'
    OR lower(path) LIKE '%.markdown'
  )
  AND strpos(CAST(data AS TEXT), 'TODO') > 0
ORDER BY path;

SELECT path, CAST(data AS TEXT) AS content
FROM lix_file
WHERE (
    lower(path) LIKE '%.md'
    OR lower(path) LIKE '%.markdown'
  )
  AND strpos(CAST(data AS TEXT), 'TODO') > 0
ORDER BY path;
